environment.description: Celery worker running in Docker container on ECS Fargate. Container runs as non-root user 'celeryworker' (uid 1000). Worker processes log extraction jobs submitted via the web API. Container has 2 vCPU and 4GB RAM allocated. No CPU/memory cgroup limits beyond Fargate task definition. Redis broker on ElastiCache. Results written to EFS mount at /var/spool/logworker/. No regex complexity analysis or timeout at the application layer beyond Celery's soft_time_limit of 300s.

config.security_context: default Docker seccomp profile, no AppArmor/SELinux
